text:
Maya: Socks vs slippers — settle this. Also my green tea went cold 5 minutes after I made it. Tragic. :tea:
Jon: Slippers forever. Socks are just a fabric prison. :slipper:
Priya: Socks for outside, slippers at desk. Compromise. Also — who keeps taking the good teaspoons? I need a proper stirrer.
Zane: Guilty. I borrowed one last week and left it in the ficus as a 'garden ornament'. Sorry not sorry. :seedling: (reaction :laughing: from Jon)
Maya: You put a spoon in a plant? Of course. That explains the tiny tin spoon shrine.
Priya: Zane no. Return the spoon before the office spoon union strikes. :raised_hand:
CoffeeBot: Heads up — free oat milk in the kitchen until 11:00. First come, first pour. :coffee:
Jon: Also pro tip: microwave your tea for 20s, tastes 70% better (science). :microwave:
Maya: That is the kind of peer-reviewed research we need at Redwood. Cite the paper. :nerd_face:
Zane: Will return spoon and bring backup teaspoons. Also starting 'slippers & spoon' merch idea. Anyone buy? :tada:
Priya: I'll buy one if it comes with a tiny plant ornament. :seedling: :ok_hand:
Maya: Poll time — vote with a reaction: :slipper: for Team Slippers, :socks: for Team Socks, :tea: if you only care about warm beverage solutions.
Jon: (casts :slipper:)
Priya: (casts :tea:)
Zane: (casts :slipper:)
CoffeeBot: Reminder: weekly kitchen tidy at 4pm today. Please clear old mugs. :broom:
Maya: Thanks everyone. Meeting adjourned — back to one-liners and snacks. :popcorn:
